purpose: H14 synthetic falsification of delayed post-checkup deep-charge Ah proxy
deep_charge_proxy_observation: group discharge capacity at that checkpoint plus an unobserved charge/discharge and initial-SOC bias plus 0.5Ah Gaussian measurement noise; analytical proxy, not physical full charge simulation
bias_modes_Ah: drift common bias 0-2 plus 0.5 per month
step common bias 0-2 plus 2 after CK3
limitation: This is model-construction stress testing. Real deep charge initial SOC and charge efficiency are unobserved, so coverage is not official calibration.
